_source: A2 (PLAN.md proposals, approved by Garv 5 Oct): the final accusation after the Archive escape, before the Finale. The player names who caused the incident and backs it with one clue from each witness; the Archive's handwriting match is shown automatically. Every slot accepts core evidence, so anyone who reached 9/9 can answer. Wrong answers get a nudge (B1 style), no penalty.
title: THE ACCUSATION
question: Who caused the incident?
intro: Three memories. One record. Name who did this.

archiveClue.title: FROM THE ARCHIVE
archiveClue.text: The unsigned case request and the apprentice log are in the same hand.

conclusions.text: Elias Vane, the apprentice. Still out there somewhere.
Leela, keeper of the lantern records.
No one. It was an accident.

reactions.me:
My staff. My initials. My hand on the case request.
I was Elias Vane. I still am.
reactions.elias_out:
Elias Vane, yes. But no one left Veyra after 2:17.
Whose hand wrote the case request?
reactions.leela:
Leela kept the records.
She never opened the network.
reactions.lantern:
A lantern doesn't choose.
Someone was holding it.
reactions.accident: An accident doesn't erase its own name.
